title: Gitartha — content sources
description: Structure of sources/sources.json. Only verified sources belong here. Unique ids are enforced by tool/validate_gita_content.dart.

text.description: Empty string = unknown. If not empty, it must not start or end with whitespace.

id.description: Stable snake_case id referenced by verse source_attributions. Never rename once used.

name.description: Title of the work, edition or dataset.

license.description: Licence or permission terms. Empty = not yet verified; content from this source must not be approved.

attribution.description: Exact credit text that must be shown with content from this source.
